{{Quote|Kynachi may be very remote, and her people may have chosen isolation, but I remember it as a lovely, peaceful world. I fear that Kynachi has joined or become occupied by the Separatists.|[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 1: Breakout Squad">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 1: Breakout Squad]]''</ref>}}
'''Kynachi''' was a remote [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and the base of [[KynachTech Industries]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the world was seized by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], and the [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Overseer/Legends|Overseer]] [[Umbrag]] took over the [[KynachTech factory]], also imposing a frequency jammer on the world. The planet's isolation led the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to believe that it had simply become isolated out of choice. The planet's captive inhabitants were [[Mission to Kynachi|liberated]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] from the [[KynachTech factory prison]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] self-proclaimed [[Breakout Squad]] [[Squad/Legends|unit]].
